create_minkowski_batch_norm: create a MinkowskiEngine batch normalization layer with a specified number of features and momentum
create_minkowski_instance_norm: create a MinkowskiEngine instance normalization layer with a specified number of features and spatial dimension
get_normalization_layer: get a MinkowskiEngine normalization layer by passing the norm type string and feature count
review_get_norm: review the get_norm function to understand how it selects between batch and instance normalization
refactor_get_norm: refactor the get_norm function to support additional normalization types beyond BN and IN
